source_line: Sources: Bombay HC order (19 Oct 2026) via Bar & Bench, Bollywood Hungama

scenes.say: A High Court just hit pause on Sonakshi Sinha's new film. Here is why.
scenes.head:
RELEASE
ON HOLD

scenes.say: Tu Hai Meri Kiran, a romantic thriller starring Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal, was set to hit theatres on October twenty-third.
scenes.head:
TU HAI
MERI KIRAN

scenes.say: But on October nineteenth, the Bombay High Court stopped its commercial release.
scenes.head:
BOMBAY
HIGH COURT

scenes.say: The reason is money. Co-producer AND Movie Products put eight point eight five crore rupees into the film, and the deal said it had to be repaid before release.
scenes.head:
₹8.85
CRORE

scenes.say: So the court told producer Echelon Productions to secure that amount, plus fifteen percent yearly interest, before the film can open.
scenes.head:
+15%
INTEREST

scenes.say: The judge said this is not about blocking the film forever. Once the money is secured, it can release, and the final dispute goes to arbitration.
scenes.head:
NOT
BANNED
scenes.sub: Can open once money is secured

scenes.say: Would you still watch it in theatres? Tell us in the comments, and follow Celebrity-Verse for more.
scenes.head:
WOULD YOU
WATCH IT?
